comment: Sampling hints for the differential corpus only. They never change the wire schema or the generated codecs; they keep generated samples inside the oracle's accepted vocabulary so whole packets remain comparable.

nbt.reason: gophertunnel decodes NBT into Go maps, re-encoding compounds in random key order and absent documents as empty compounds; single-entry compounds keep oracle output byte-comparable. Zig unit tests cover multi-entry and absent documents. Empty lists use the TAG_End element type, which gophertunnel writes for every empty list.

InventoryTransaction.legacy_request_id.reason: gophertunnel derives the legacy-slot presence flag from the request ID (present only for even IDs below -1).

list:DataItemEntry.reason: gophertunnel decodes actor metadata into a Go map, so re-encoding reorders entries and drops duplicate keys.

type:ItemInstance.reason: gophertunnel reads deprecated craft-result items with only empty or item-name descriptors, and writes an empty user-data buffer for an empty item.

CameraFadeColor.red.reason: gophertunnel converts fade colour components to 8-bit channels, so only exact channel values survive its re-encode.

RecipeUnlockRequirementSerializedData.un.reason: gophertunnel writes unlocking ingredients exactly when the context is none.

MaterialReducerDataEntry.from_item_key.reason: gophertunnel shifts the item network ID left instead of right when reading the combined key, so its re-encode keeps only the low 15 bits; that oracle defect does not affect protocol-zig, which keeps the raw key.

MapTrackedObject.type.reason: gophertunnel rejects the documented other (2) tracked object type.

PlayerAuthInput.input_data.reason: gophertunnel stores input flags as a set and rejects repeated flags; vanilla sends each flag once.
